## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Navattabbaṁsaṁghassadinnaṁmahapphalantikathā* ("Debate on the proposition that it should not be said that what is given to the Saṅgha brings great fruit") is a debate within the seventeenth chapter of the *Kathāvatthu*, the fifth book of the Theravāda *Abhidhamma Piṭaka*.

 The core theme of giving to the Saṅgha and its fruits is also cited in connection with the *Dakkhiṇāvibhaṅga Sutta* (MN 142), the *Gotamivatthadānapañha* of the *Milindapañha* (Mil 6.1.2), the *Yajamānasutta* (SN 11.16), and several canonical and commentarial texts preserved in Chinese (including MĀ 180, T 84, T 202.52, T 203.50, T 212.14, T 1509.22, and T 1545.178) and Tibetan (Up 4.103).

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog data.*
